Plot Decision Study (D-Study) Reliability Curves

Source: R/autoplot.R
autoplot.llm_d_study.Rd

Visualizes projected Generalizability (\(E\rho^2\)) or Dependability (\(\Phi\)) curves across candidate facet counts, marking the target reliability threshold and highlighting the lowest-cost recommended design.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'llm_d_study'
autoplot(object, metric = NULL, ...)

Arguments

object

An "llm_d_study" object returned by d_study().

metric

Optional override: "g", "phi", or "both". Defaults to object$metric.

...

Unused; included for S3 consistency.

Value

A ggplot2::ggplot object.

Examples

data(ema_coded)
g <- g_study(ema_coded, score_col = "llm_score", facets = c("prompt", "model"))
d <- d_study(g, grid = list(prompt = 1:8, model = 1:4), target = 0.85)
autoplot(d)
